description: Industrial New Orders measures the change in the total value of new purchase orders placed with manufacturers. It is a leading indicator of production.<BR/><BR/>A higher than expected reading should be taken as positive/bullish for the EUR, while a lower than expected reading should be taken as negative/bearish for the EUR.

A monthly report by the Chicago Federal Reserve Bank that tracks economic activity in the 7th district, which is comprised of Indiana, Iowa, Illinois, Michigan and Wisconsin. The index is useful in tracking economic growth and identifying potential inflation.<BR/><BR/>A higher than expected reading should be taken as positive/bullish for the USD, while a lower than expected reading should be taken as negative/bearish for the USD.

European Central Bank (ECB) President Jean-Claude Trichet (November 2003 - October 2011) is to speak. As head of the ECB, which sets short term interest rates, he has a major influence over the value of the euro. Traders watch his speeches closely as they are often used to drop subtle hints regarding future monetary policy and interest rate shifts.<BR/><BR/>His comments may determine a short-term positive or negative trend.

The Consumer Price Index (CPI) measures the change in the price of goods and services from the perspective of the consumer. It is a key way to measure changes in purchasing trends and inflation.<BR/><BR/>A higher than expected reading should be taken as positive/bullish for the NZD, while a lower than expected reading should be taken as negative/bearish for the NZD.
